about: Front-page check results, one per host in front-page-hosts.json (server/catalog-store/frontPageCheck.js; owner decision, 23 November 2026: "Record it once and then store it in the code"). Each result is what the app's own production server saw, once, asking the host's robots.txt and then its front page as MyBookshelf/1.0, with no search: the date (UTC), the HTTP status of the front page (null when it was not asked or did not answer), the wall signal (none, challenge, 403, 429 or unreachable), the host a redirect moved it to (movedTo), and, when robots.txt stopped the check before the page, why (robots: disallowed, unavailable or crawl-delay). A host listed here is never asked again; remove its result to ask again. Written by tools/deployment/front-page-results.mjs from the production log lines (front-page-check {json}).
